Logs and CSVs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-halal-rider/ec562e35-ea9e-5a74-ab92-4ff22c5eeb77/scratchpad/pb_out_w90/wr90.
r.method:
KERNEL. w90_wr90_lib.wkernel is a copy of engine.gkernel (full take-profit only) with new switches:
- pens: sell-side fill penalty.
- lastb: a position in LUNA/FTT/SRM is sold at the coin's last real close.
- pmode=1 profit-only time stop: after hm hours the target drops to break-even +0.25%.
- hs: catastrophe stop at an hourly close; hmax: maximum hold.
- Positions still open at the end are marked at the last close and counted in the win rate.
- The crash guard is x10_universe_push2.guard_mask (skip a coin whose last close is more than g under its 168h high close).

EQUIVALENCE. With every switch off, wrun equals engine.run exactly: identical equity and trade logs in 16 cases (19 and 22 coins, guard 0/35%, mtp_now, pen, tpwait). Turning liquidation on with no collapse coin changes nothing (w90_wr90_lib.py check(), check.log and check2.log).

METRICS. %/month is compounded from the account value just before each period starts. Win rate counts trades bought in the period. Worst drop uses hourly mark-to-market equity. The calibration reproduces the stated facts exactly (calib.log):
- Live: 93.6/92.5/91.5%, +4.98/+2.89/+1.96%/month.
- 10% mode: 81.1/76.5/75.0%, +15.03/+8.13/+6.08%/month, drops -61/-30/-29%.
- 10% mode, bot timing + buys 0.2% worse: +14.39/+7.19/+5.14 (matches REFINE.md).

STRESSED VERSION. Real bot timing (mtp_now=True, cooldown +1h), every fill 0.2% worse on buys AND sells, and LUNA/FTT/SRM added with liquidation at the cut (0.1% slippage on those coins). I also report a buy-side-only penalty, which is the REFINE.md convention.

GRIDS. Each design was run normal and stressed: 1,328 distinct designs, 2,832 runs.
- A (336, written before any result): sizing {1x100, 2x50, 2x100, 3x33, 3x50, 4x25, 4x50} x depth {10,12,14,16} x tp {1,1.5,2,3} x hm {48,96,168}, cooldown 24h, guard 35%.
- B (288): the top 24 qualifiers of A x cooldown {6,12,24} x guard {0,25,35,50}.
- C (144): the top 12 of A+B with the profit-only time stop: hm {48,96} x stop {off,25,40} x max hold {off,720h}.
- D (288, hindsight): {1x100, 2x50} x depth 12-15 x tp {1,1.25,1.5,2,2.5,3} x hm {72,96,120} x cooldown {3,6}, guard 35.
- E (320, hindsight): low-drop corner, N 3-5, depth 15-18, tp 1.5-3, hm {96,168}, cooldown {6,24}.
- F (40, hindsight): 5 leaders x catastrophe stop {0,30,40,50} x guard {25,35}.

RULE (fixed by the task). A design qualifies if its win rate is at least 90% in 2021-23 AND 2024-26. The pick has the highest minimum of the three periods' %/month; a tie goes to the shallower worst drop. 1,166 of 1,328 designs qualify. Because the rule reads 2024-26 and since-2025, every pick is in-sample on 2021-26.

CHECKS. Robustness (w90_wr90_robust.py): one-at-a-time neighbours (depth ±0.25/0.5 pt, tp ±0.25 pt, hm ±24, cooldown, guard ±5) and 30 fresh start dates in 2024 and in 2025. The holdout functions were run through holdout_eval's exact call path on the 2021-26 panel and reproduce the grid numbers (final.log).

REFERENCES:
- Live: win rate 93.6/92.5/91.5%; +5.0/+2.9/+2.0%/month; drop -29%. Stressed +1.7/+2.1/+1.2, drop -43%.
- 10% mode: win rate 81/77/75%; +15.0/+8.1/+6.1; drop -61%.

10%/MONTH: no design reaches 10% in 2024-26 (0 of 1,328 at any win rate, though my grids used targets of 3% or less). At a win rate of 90% or more:
- Best 2024-26: +7.31% (N1 d13 tp1.25 hm96 cd6 g35: +9.7/+7.3/+5.2, drop -69%).
- Best since 2025: +5.85%.
- Holding 90% costs about 0.2 points of minimum monthly return compared with the 10% mode (5.85 vs 6.08), but 1.5 points in 2024-26.

BEST DESIGN AT EACH WIN-RATE LEVEL (normal time stop):
- 85-88%: N1 d14 tp3 hm48 cd24: +9.7/+6.2/+4.2, drop -72%.
- 88-90%: N1 d14 tp3 hm96 cd12: +15.4/+5.4/+4.6, drop -56%.
- 90-92%: N1 d14 tp3 hm96 cd3: +14.3/+6.9/+5.3, drop -64%.
- 92-94%: F2 (+13.2/+6.9/+5.8, drop -64%), or F2 with a 50% stop (+12.6/+6.9/+5.8, drop -62%).
- 94-95%: N1 d12 tp1.25 hm96 cd3: +14.8/+6.6/+5.8, drop -72% (stressed since 2025 -0.5%).
- 95-96%: N1 d12 tp1 hm96 cd3: +14.1/+6.3/+5.4, drop -66%.
- 96-97%: F1 (the rule pick): +10.7/+6.6/+5.85, drop -64%.
- 97-98%: N1 d15 tp1.25 hm120 cd3: +10.8/+5.1/+4.3, drop -64%.
- 98% and above: only the profit-only time stop, e.g. N2x50 d14 tp3 hm96 cd6 g35 at 99.8/99.6/99.3% and +10.5/+6.6/+4.9, but drop -80% with half the account frozen 4.4 years.
- Pattern: inside these grids a lower win rate does not buy more return. Targets of 1-1.25% top the normal runs but are fragile under stress; 2.5-3% targets hold up.

WORST-DROP CAPS at win rate 90%+ (normal drop at or above the cap, stressed drop within 5 points):
- -25%: N5x40 d16 tp2 hm96 cd24 g35: +5.3/+2.7/+1.7.
- -30%: LOWDD N4x50 d16 tp2 hm96 cd24 g35:
  - Win rate 96.6/97.5/96.3%; +5.9/+3.0/+2.0; drop -19/-14/-8%; stressed +4.1/+2.5/+1.3, drop -34%.
  - Better win rate and drop than live at the same return.
- -35%: N4x25 d12 tp1.5 hm96 cd24 g35: +6.5/+4.3/+2.9, drop -31%.
- -40%: M: +10.5/+5.5/+4.0, drop -35% (stressed -41%).
- -50%: N2x50 d14 tp3 hm120 cd6 g35: +11.1/+6.3/+4.5, drop -48%.
- No cap: F1, minimum +5.85, drop -64%.

PROFIT-ONLY TIME STOP (a requested lever). It lifts the win rate to 98-100%, but returns fall and drops deepen in every case:
- F2: 100/99.1/98.4%; +12.2/+6.6/+5.1; drops -93/-71/-55% (RENDER held 707 days).
- M: 99.7/99.6/99.2%; drop -70%; a BCH position bought May 2021 is still open 1,988 days later at -79%; 3 positions are open at the end.
- Live: 99.8/99.0/98.0%; since 2025 -0.17%/month; 8 positions open, LINK held since May 2021 at -68%.
- One coin, +1% target: the account froze in one coin from 2021 on (no 2024-26 trades at all).
- A 30-day maximum hold or a 40% stop is still worse than the plain time stop (F2 with max hold: drop -80/-47/-34%).
- Stressed, the win rate falls back to 92-94%, because break-even exits turn into small losses.
- Verdict: the high win rate is cosmetic, and I rejected this lever.

OTHER LEVERS:
- Catastrophe stops of 30-50% never raise the minimum monthly return; they only change 2021-23.
- A 35% guard is needed for 1-coin designs, or LUNA wipes the account in the stressed run.
- A 25% guard cuts the 2-coin designs' stressed LUNA drop from -75% to -41%.
- Cooldowns of 3-6h beat 24h for concentrated designs.
- Every concentrated design's worst drop is in 2021-23 (May 2021, May 2022).

r.summary:
ANSWER
- The live bot already meets the 90% goal.
- With a win rate held at 90% or more in both 2021-23 and 2024-26, the most monthly return is about +5.8% since 2025 and +6.6-6.9% in 2024-26, with a -64% worst drop.
- That needs one coin with all the money, a 13-14% dip, a +1.25-2.5% target, a 96h time stop, a 3h cooldown and the 35% crash guard.
- 10% a month is not reached at that win rate in any of 1,328 designs (best 2024-26 +7.3%, best since 2025 +5.85%), so meeting both goals at once is out of reach here.
- All picks were found by looking at all of 2021-26. They are in-sample, and only the 2018-20 holdout is a fair test.

THE RULE'S PICK (F1)
- 1 coin x 100%, 13%, +1.25%, 96h, cooldown 3h, guard 35%, 30% catastrophe stop.
- Win rate 96.2 / 96.3 / 96.8%; +10.7 / +6.6 / +5.85%/month; drop -64%.
- Stressed: +4.1 / +5.1 / +3.8, drop -74%.
- It wins a tie against its config-only twin on drop only. The twin (no stop, no code change) has identical numbers since 2024 and does better under stress.
- Weakness: the +1.25% target is thin against 0.2% worse fills.

F2: a better practical choice
- 14%, +2.5%, otherwise the same; config only.
- Within 0.05 points of F1 on the rule: +13.2 / +6.9 / +5.8%/month, win rate 93.8 / 92.6 / 93.2%.
- Stressed: +11.0 / +5.5 / +4.4, win rate stays above 90%.
- Flatter neighbourhood (median 5.80 vs 5.35).
- Both F1 and F2 can lose up to half the account on one trade (DOGE, January 2021).

M: smaller drops
- 2 coins x 50%, 14%, +2.5%, 96h, cooldown 3h, guard 25%.
- +10.5 / +5.5 / +4.0%/month; drop -35%; stressed drop -41%.
- Its since-2025 win rate (90.9%) is close to the line.

LOWDD: a reference, not a finalist
- 4 coins x 50%, 16%, +2%, 96h, cooldown 24h; config only.
- Beats live on win rate (96.6 / 97.5%) and drop (-19%) at the same return (+2.0%/month since 2025).
- Function: w90_wr90_final.py:holdout_candidate_lowdd.

PROFIT-ONLY TIME STOP
- It pushes the win rate to 98-100% but lowers returns and deepens drops to -55% to -93%, by holding losers for months or years: a BCH position bought May 2021 is still open at -79%.
- It is a cosmetic win rate, not a better bot. Rejected.

FOR THE LEAD
- Run the holdout from research/panic_buyer/refine:
  `holdout_eval.py w90_wr90_final.py:holdout_candidate_f1 w90_wr90_final.py:holdout_candidate_f2 w90_wr90_final.py:holdout_candidate_m`
- Each function returns (name, spec dict, w90_wr90_lib.wrun). The runner has engine.run's signature and computes the guard from whatever panel it gets.

- w90_wr90_calib.py

r.summary:
VERDICT: 10%/month does not hold with the hourly bot on the 19 coins, not even with hindsight.

- I tested 1,010 designs (943 with distinct results) built from every allowed change: per-coin depth tiers by own volatility, crash-guard threshold and lookback, 1-2 coins (1-4 in the frontier grid), take-profit 1.5-8%, time stop 24-120h, cooldown 6-48h, re-arm after a win, a second smaller order deeper, and take-profit relative to the 24h high. I also tested extra levers: trigger window and slower take-profit.
- None reaches even 9%/month in 2024-26. The maximum is +8.76%; since 2025 the maximum is +7.46%. The best worst-of-three (2021-23, 2024-26, since 2025) is about +7.2-7.4%.
- When stressed (the real bot's timing, every fill 0.2% worse, LUNA/FTT/SRM added), the best is about +7.1% in 2024-26 and +5.9% since 2025. 10% mode itself gives +6.47 / +4.60 under the same stress.
- The leaders sit on noisy peaks:
  - one-step neighbours have medians of +5.4-5.9%;
  - moving the depth 0.5 point changes results by 1-3 points;
  - picking on 2021-23 alone gave 4-5% in 2024-26 and 0-3% since 2025.

WHY: the limit is the number of dips, not how they are traded. Since 2025, 10% mode holds a coin only 9% of the hours, makes 2.6 trades a month at +2.3% on average, and 48 of 56 trades are in the most volatile third of the coins.

WHAT EACH CHANGE DID:
- Shallower triggers on calm coins or volatility-scaled depth: always hurt.
- Crash guard: 35-40% over 168h is best. 25-30%, or a 336h lookback, costs 1-3 points; 72h works like no guard.
- Second order deeper on the same coin: lowers drops but costs 0.5-2 points.
- Take-profit relative to the 24h high: noise on market buys only; -1.5 to -5 points on every fill.
- 2 coins x 50%: costs 1-2 points but halves the worst trade and the 2021-23 drop.
- Near-trigger filter: -2 to -4 points.
- Re-arm after a win: since 2025 goes from +6.1% to +7.0%, but 2024-26 drops from +8.1% to +7.5%, and the gain disappears under stress.

THE 90% WIN RATE IS THE REAL FINDING. The win rate trades off for free: about +7%/month at 70%, 90% and 96%.
- F1 (15% dip, +4%, 96h, re-arm, guard 35%): win rate 91 / 90 / 90%, +17.6 / +8.3 / +7.0 %/month. Its 2024-26 win rate is borderline and drops to 88% when stressed.
- F2 (13% dip, +1.5%, 96h, re-arm, guard 35%): win rate 96 / 95 / 96% even when stressed, +15.9 / +7.1 / +6.7 %/month (stressed +9.6 / +4.5 / +4.1).
- For comparison, the live bot makes +2.0-2.9% at a 92-94% win rate.
- The cost is all-in concentration: worst drops of -61 to -64% (2021-23) and -35 to -37% (2024-26), and single trades losing up to -48% of the account.
- A lower-risk frontier point is 2 coins x 50%, 13% dip, +1.5%, 96h, re-arm: win rate 96%, +12.5 / +6.3 / +5.1, drop -48 / -26 / -23%, worst trade -24%.
- F1 and F2 need a small code change (cooldown_after_win_hours = 0; the diff is in scratchpad botpatch/, not applied). F3 is config only.

THE REAL CODE MATCHES: a patched copy of panic_buyer.py replayed through the fake exchange matches the engine with the bot's timing within about 0.5 point per month.

All numbers are hindsight: the round's rule itself uses 2024-26 and since-2025. The 2018-20 holdout is the only real test. The lead runs it through w90_tenh_final.holdout_candidate_F1/F2/F3 and their _stressed versions. I checked that these reproduce evaluate() exactly.

r.method:
KERNEL: w90_watch_lib.wkernel, a 1-minute kernel. mode=0 is x10_critic_lib.xkernel's minute watch path copied line for line. w90_watch_check.py shows it gives identical trade logs and zero equity difference against xkernel(watch=1) in 16 cases: 19 and 22 coins, original and 1%-trimmed wicks, 1x100% / 3x33%, hourly and every-minute re-check, take-profit delay, fills 0.2% worse. The crash-guard mask is identical to the critic's.

The new mechanic is mode=1, and every one of its trades was audited against the raw minute arrays: 4 runs, 1,676 trades, 0 violations. How it works:
- Every minute, each eligible coin is compared with the live trigger: the highest hourly close of the 24 closed hours x (1 - depth). A coin is eligible when it has no position, its cooldown is over and the crash guard (last hourly close vs the 168h high close) does not exclude it.
- The coin is triggered when the minute's low touches the trigger (the wick-trimmed low; det=0).
- It is bought at MARKET at the next minute's open x 1.0005, sized min(fmax x equity, cash), while fewer than N positions are open. Coins triggered in the same minute are served deepest-under-trigger first.
- The take-profit limit is placed at once and fills at its limit price, from the minute after the fill, when a minute's trimmed high is 0.1% through it.
- Time stop: the engine rule (the hourly close at least hm hours after the fill, minus 0.05%). Cooldown: cd x 60 minutes after the sale.
- Fees 0.1% per side; wicks trimmed with the x10_critic_wicks.py arithmetic; 10 Oct 2025 included.
- Equity is marked hourly (engine convention). The lowest minute-close mark inside each hour is also reported ("minute marks").
- STRESSED = 22 coins (+LUNA/FTT/SRM), every buy AND sell 0.2% worse, cooldown noticed 1h later (cd+1). The take-profit is already placed at once, which is what mtp_now models for the hourly bot. A coin that stops trading cannot be sold and blocks its slot, marked at its last price, as in every earlier stress run.

I found three wider-universe designs that make 10%/month in both 2021-23 and 2024-26 in the normal backtest. All three were tuned with 2024-26 visible, and none holds 10% under stress, with stricter fills, or at nearby settings.

**90% win rate.** No design meets both goals. The live bot already has over 90%. The best wider design that keeps 90% or more in both periods makes 6.6 / 8.0 / 5.8 %/month (2021-23 / 2024-26 / since 2025):
- 19 coins plus a 30-day-volume top-20 tier at 22% and 0.75 size, +2% take-profit, 14% core, all-in one coin.
- Worst drop -65%. Stressed: 5.3 / 5.7 / 2.7.

- The rule picks F1: 16.0 / 11.1 / 12.0, drops -58 / -31 / -29%. Stressed it falls to 8.8 / 8.2 / 8.4 with a -91% drop: its 12h cooldown re-bought FTT into the collapse (-79% of the account).

**What the tier really adds.** This part is steady:
- About +2.3 to +3.5 points/month in 2024-26 and +3.6 to +6.2 since 2025, at every core depth from 13% to 15%.
- About 0 in 2021-23: only 7 tier trades with the 365-day ranking. With the 30-day ranking the tier lost money in 2021-23 (LOOM, BNT, PHA).
- For the 2024-26 10% mode, that lifts 8.1 to about 10-11 and 6.1 since 2025 to about 10-11.

- Neighbouring settings have a worst-of-three median of 8.4-9.4%, with only 3-4 of 12 qualifying.
- Moving F2's tier depth by 2 points gives 8.1-9.6% in 2024-26.

- Orders that must trade 0.3% through: 9.5-9.7 in 2024-26. 1% through: 4-6.
